story: In the diverse world of birds, the Bearded Vulture (Gypaetus barbatus) stands out. This species, part of the Accipitridae family, is a resident of High mountainous regions; cliffs; precipices; gorges; and open areas like grasslands and meadows. Its IUCN Red List status is Near Threatened (NT), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Bearded Vulture is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Bearded Vulture and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
